transcript: Speaker A: बेटी का होमवर्क था। मुझसे दोबारा पूछा ही नहीं क्योंकि उसे पता है मम्मी को इंग्लिश नहीं आती। [It was my daughter's homework. She didn't even ask me again because she knows mom doesn't know English.] Speaker B: तो क्या लिखा फिर? [So what did she write then?] Speaker A: कुछ नहीं, बेटी ने खुद लिख लिया। मुझसे पूछा ही नहीं दोबारा। [Nothing, daughter wrote it herself. Didn't ask me again.] Speaker B: और वो लगा कैसा? [And how did that feel?] Speaker A: बुरा लगा। अपनी ही बेटी के सामने कुछ नहीं आता। [Felt bad. Knowing nothing in front of my own daughter.] Speaker B: तो आज से शुरू करते हैं। Assessment का मतलब क्या होता है? एक बार बोल। [So let's start from today. What does 'Assessment' mean? Say it once.] Speaker A: Evaluation, जांच? [Evaluation, check?] Speaker B: बिल्कुल सही। कल PTM में टीचर बोलेगी, तुम समझोगी। परसों बोलेगी, तुम जवाब दोगी। [Absolutely right. Tomorrow the teacher will speak in PTM, you will understand. The day after she speaks, you will answer.] Speaker A: जवाब दूंगा नहीं, दूंगी। [Not 'answer' (masculine), 'answer' (feminine).] Speaker B: सही पकड़ा। रोज़ 10 मिनट, बस इतना। [Caught it right. 10 minutes daily, just that.] Speaker A: चलो, अगली वर्ड बोलो। [Come on, say the next word.] Speaker B: रोज़ 10 मिनट इंग्लिश सीखो पे। Vocabulary, grammar, PTM वाली इंग्लिश, सब। ट्राई करो आज से। [10 minutes daily on English Seekho. Vocabulary, grammar, PTM English, everything. Try from today.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai...
summary: A mother shares her embarrassment over not knowing English when her daughter does homework. An AI avatar encourages her to practice 10 minutes daily on the English Seekho app to prepare for school meetings. The ad concludes with a call to install the app.
